reviews.t: Works as described.  Use taller 3 oz cups with pump.
reviews.x: Bought the pump for my elderly mother-in-law who has difficulty lifting the larger size mouthwash bottles and opening the caps.  Works fine for our needs.  Pros: Fits Listerine Zero 1.5L bottles.  Can't comment on whether it fits other brands or sizes but based on previous reviews, sounds like it doesn't fit other brands. Makes it easier to dispense product vs. lifting and pouring out product. Inexpensive solution - I paid $6.50 with free Prime shipping.  Cons: Pump dispenses additional product

reviews.t: I got this to keep my countertop clean
reviews.x: Before I got this pump, my bathroom counter perpetually had little crystals of dried listerine all over it. I conscientiously wiped  down the outside of the bottle every single time I used the cap to measure mouthwash, but my husband’s habits were different than mine. So, listerine crystals. SO ANNOYING TO CLEAN. Well. I got this and a decorative cup to dispense into for our bathroom. My counters have never stayed so clean so long!!! 2 days ago I was brushing my teeth next to hubby and I saw him

reviews.t: Use more than once with proper cleaning, fits perfectly on Listerine bottles.
reviews.x: Works great in a Listerine bottle, AND ONLY A LISTERINE BOTTLE! does not work with other brands. My remedy is to purchase 2 Listerine bottles, and once they’re gone, I run through the dishwasher, and refill with comparable mouthwash from Costco. By using 2, I can refill one immediately while the other one is in the dishwasher.  The description says one-time use only. Definitely not one-time use at this cost!!! After each bottle of mouthwash, I pump hot water through the pump device to clean it o

Love my new listerine pump. It help me to dispense better my mouthwash to last it longer and keep my bathroom cleaner by avoiding spills. The only negative points (that's why I removed a star), this pump only works with listerine brand and doesn't work with the store brand listerine bottles and the instruction booklet said that you will need to replace it after every bottle (no planing to do that).

reviews.t: Apparently for Listerine bottles only.  Not universal fit.
reviews.x: Seems decently made. I can confirm that this pump  does not mate with Costco's Kirkland brand of mouthwash in the 1.5 liter bottle, No surprise there.  The listing does specify Listerine.  I'll buy :Listerine and reuse the bottle with the Costco or Sams Club mouthwash.

reviews.t: Be aware this is LARGE. Very large. (Read on.)
reviews.x: I was looking forward to using this pump, rather than taking the cover off the Listerine bottle every time to use it. Although the items was "as described" (which had no dimension listed, only that it fit either the 1 or 1.5 liter bottle of Listerine ONLY)  I had no idea how HUGE this would be, once attached to at least a one liter bottle. The pump goes approx 2 inches above the lip of the already large bottle, with no options for use on smaller sized bottle. I already had a 500 ml bottl

reviews.t: Hard to find item accoding to my dentist.  They use this in their office.
reviews.x: I use mouth rinse twice a day as does my wife, so this gets 4 uses, 10-12 pumps a day.  Much better than the decanter we had that started leaking.  There is some drippage from the spout, so you will want a small catch plate under it to contain the splash.

The BEST purchase ever! I buy the large bottles of Listerine from Costco and I'm sure as most know they are large, heavy & bulky which makes it hard to dispense the right amount and not very comfortable when picking up. Wasn't sure if I should buy this after reading some reviews saying that they do not fit the Costco bottles, or that they were as big as the ones at the Denist office. WELL for starters they fit PERFECTLY & work just as well! And for being as large as the ones at the Dentist offic

reviews.t: good for dispensing Listerine mouthwash without waste
reviews.x: i've been searching for a solution to using my 1 litre Listerine. usually, i have to squeeze the cap and rotate to remove it. then, pour enough mouthwash into the cap and swig. the whole process of squeezing to remove the cap is bothersome along with sometimes pouring out too much.  i purchased this pump to put on my bottle, and now i can dispense the quantity i need into a small glass by measured amounts. i don't waste Listerine anymore by pouring out too much and having to pour the excess back

reviews.t: The pump works and is convenient to have and use ...
reviews.x: The pump works and is convenient to have and use. Sometimes the pump releases a little bit of extra Listerine after I have pushed the pump down and released it to return to the upright position. This extra release of Listerine creates a spill the size of a drop or two on the countertop.

THIS IS PERFECT for anyone who may struggle with opening the caps on the Listerine bottles.  Also, if you are someone that is always in a rush (like me) it makes for a quick, easy way to dispense your mouthwash.  I plan to purchase one now for my Mom who has athritis in her hands.  Highly recommend this product!

reviews.t: Does what you need it to do, pump Listerine...works great!
reviews.x: Pump fits well on the 1.5L Listerine bottles. I’ve been using the pump for about 2 weeks now and works perfectly. I recommend purchasing this pump.

When I would go to the dentist, I coveted the pump mouthwash. I finally got this about 2 years ago and it's everything I hoped it would be. It dispenses just the right amount of mouthwash, and most importantly, it keeps unnamed people from drinking from the bottle, which is disgusting. I use it on off-brand mouthwash and wrap a little flexible non-adhesive bandage around the threads so it fits just fine.

reviews.t: Not the same pump as pictured
reviews.x: The dispensing pump was not the same unit as pictured in product page. While it did screw onto the Listerine bottle the threads didn't feel right and the cap sits at a slight angle indicating it's cross threaded.  The screw collar itself was much shorter (1.5cm) than pictured (approx.. 3cm).  The liquid pickup tube was 5cm short of reaching the bottom of standard 1.5L Listerine bottle.  In summary I believe the wrong pump was sent.

I discovered the joys of pumping mouthwash at my dentist's office. I guess I'm pretty lazy, as the thought of increasing the cap, pouring, and screwing the cap back on has kept me from using mouthwash for years. But now, I simply push on the pump and I'm in business. The pump is nice and puts out the right amount of liquid per pump. Two things: As everyone else has mentioned, this is labeled as a single use item. I have not followed these guidelines and continue to use my pump. Also, as others h

We finally found these. These pumps make using our Listerine so much easier. They do NOT squirt, but rather come out in a moderate stream. Just don't mash down on the pump, but use a smooth steady motion.  They do NOT appear to "drip" after dispensing that we could see. I guess we'll just have to see how it holds up. Listerine usually leaves a crystalline buildup, but so far so good. Usually just rinsing with warm water will remove these crystals.

reviews.t: thought it was a good idea
reviews.x: Initially the product was effective. However it has a metal spring that started rusting about 30 days after it was screwed onto the Listerine. it was pumping rust into my mouthwash so...not such a good product in the long run.

reviews.t: Listerine Pump for one handed person and elderly
reviews.x: I usually buy a different mouthwash  (Scope) but can't find a pump designed for it. I have to buy Listerine 1.5 Liter. Since my daughter was injured (broke her metacarpal bone from dodgeball), I have to find a way that will make it easy for her to pour mouthwash in a cup. Especially if someone's arm/hand is in a cast. This is helpful also for elderly, especially those with arthritis.

We use this pump on a 1.5 Liter Listerine bottle. We cup our hand over the pump into the Dixie 3 oz disposable cup, this way it helps with the slightest spray that we noticed when pressing with 2 fingers. It also feels better!  We pump once all the way till it stops and it gives the amount we need.
Works great for my needs. It allows every one even guests to be able to use the mouth wash. Dispenses the right amount each time.
Fits perfectly in the 1 and 1/5 L Listerine Bottle. Thanks guys!

Works exactly as advertised and is quite an easy install. Came in a time locked bag. Was easy to open and easy to install. Had no problem on the pump pressure and works quite fluidly with liquids. I would truly recommend this to anyone using for Listerine.
It works, but it also splashes half the liquid out of the cup... you have to be extremely careful and use a very slight pressure... still might splash your mouthwash all over the sink.
The pump continuously leaked. Left a stain on my counter.

I wanted something my mother could use by herself. She had a stroke and only has use of her left hand. This is a great concept however, if you keep the cup on the counter, there is a lot of splash. I tried to show her how to hold the cup and push down on this at the same time but it's difficult for her. So now I just put some in the cup for her which really defeats the purpose of her being able to do it herself and I noticed even with 2 hands and holding the cup right under it, it still splashes

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pump for making mouthwash easy to dispense, especially for people who struggle with opening caps or lifting heavy bottles.
Many reviewers note the pump fits Listerine bottles well but does not work with other brands such as Kirkland or store-brand bottles.
Several reviewers mention the pump helps keep the bathroom counter cleaner by preventing spills and drips, though a few note minor dripping from the spout.
A few reviewers comment on the pump's large size or that the unit received differed from the pictured product.

qa.q: Will this pump fit my 1.5 liter Listerine bottle?
qa.answer: Yes, multiple reviewers confirm it fits 1.5L Listerine bottles [4][6], though one reviewer noted the pickup tube was 5cm short of reaching the bottom of a standard 1.5L bottle [5].

claims.text: The pump fits well on 1.5L Listerine bottles.
One reviewer found the liquid pickup tube was 5cm short of reaching the bottom of a standard 1.5L Listerine bottle.

qa.q: Does it fit 1 liter bottles too?
qa.answer: Yes, reviews confirm it fits 1 liter Listerine bottles [1][2][5].

claims.text: It fits the 1 liter Listerine bottle.

qa.q: Is the pump durable and does it last?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on durability: one reviewer has used it for about 2 years [4], while another notes the instructions say to replace it after every bottle [1]. Other reviews report leaking [3] and occasional extra drips [2], but do not directly address long-term durability.

claims.text: One reviewer has used the pump for about 2 years.
The instructions reportedly say to replace it after every bottle.
One reviewer reports the pump continuously leaked.
One reviewer reports occasional extra drips after pumping.

qa.q: How much does it dispense per pump?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it easy to install and use?
qa.answer: Reviews describe it as easy to install and user-friendly [1][2], though one reviewer notes it only works with Listerine brand bottles and requires replacement after every bottle [4].

claims.text: It is easy to install and user-friendly.
It only works with Listerine brand bottles and the instructions say to replace it after every bottle.
